HomePage.heroDescription: Planora is an all-in-one platform that enables you to plan projects quickly, manage them efficiently, and collaborate seamlessly with your team.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.subTitle: Deliver Your Projects on Time
timeline.shortDesc: Visually plan the start and end of every task with Gantt charts.
timeline.longDesc: Planora's advanced Timeline tool allows you to visualize your projects from A to Z. Easily identify the critical path to prevent bottlenecks.

tasks.title: Task Management
tasks.subTitle: Keep Every Task Under Control
tasks.shortDesc: Control all your tasks from different perspectives with Kanban, list, and calendar views.
tasks.longDesc: Instantly switch between Kanban boards, list, or calendar views according to your project needs.

account.title: Account Management
account.subTitle: Google or Manual Login
account.shortDesc: One-click login with Google for a quick start, or register with traditional email.
account.longDesc: The Account Management module offers two flexible login options: sign in instantly with your Google account or register with email.
